title: The Glass Room Protocol
setting_summary: Two negotiators are locked in a transparent, soundproof chamber for a continuous 72-hour session to draft a new rights charter, with a live audience and a ticking clock. The room's climate, lighting, and communication are controlled by an external operator, creating pressure to compromise or break. Their opposing ideologies—security versus liberty—set the stage for debating dignity, free expression, life, and equality.
